_status: draft 0.2 for review: colors from sent emails (source of truth), fonts provisional, components.html hand-tailored from this file on 2026-09-24 (do not regenerate with build_kit.py)
_doc: Every brand-specific value of the email kit. build_kit.py replaces each %%group.key%% in components.template.html with the value here and writes components.html. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Values are inserted as raw HTML: escape '&' as '&' in text. A value may reference another token (e.g. %%meta.brand_name%%). The neutral grey / blue-grey values below exist only so the template renders; none of them is a default for any real brand.

meta._doc: Identity of the kit. brand_name comes from the brand's context brief; lang from the brand brief (content language); esp and merge syntax from the delivery setup (ESP documentation). kit_status stays 'draft for review' until the kit is approved.
meta.esp: Omnisend (detected on site); not needed for the Figma delivery
meta.merge_first_name: not used: the sent emails never personalize by name (owner decision 2026-09-24)
meta.source_note: Colors measured on the five September 2026 sent emails (source of truth for this brand), matched to the Brand Identity Guide swatches. Fonts are a provisional Google Fonts substitute for the licensed Sweet Sans and display serif.

color._doc: Brand palette. Source: official style guide / toolbox (never component tokens of a working file until confirmed against the style guide). Record file + page/node for each hex in the kit README. Check contrast: text and text_muted on surface and surface_alt >= 4.5:1; on_primary on primary >= 4.5:1; on_accent_* on accent_* >= 4.5:1; on_dark_* on dark >= 4.5:1.
color._contrast_rule: Orange #FF6400 as text only on Tap Shoe (4.77:1) and Patriot Blue (4.84:1); on Major Brown only large headline text (3.46:1). On white / #E2DDD9: labels #5C5249, links #2A2B2D underlined, accent word #2A2B2D in the serif. On the Aluminum texture (mean #9F9888): all text #2A2B2D (#5C5249 = 2.65:1). Button: #FF6400 fill + #2A2B2D text (4.77:1).

dark_mode._doc: Colors applied by Apple Mail / iOS (prefers-color-scheme) and the Outlook app ([data-ogsc]/[data-ogsb]). Derived from the brand's darkest palette color, not invented: page darkest, surface one step lighter, band one step lighter again. heading/body/link must pass 4.5:1 on surface and band. Gmail ignores these and inverts on its own.
dark_mode.heading: #F1EEEB
dark_mode._note: muted lightened from #A39A8C (4.4:1 on band #34353A, failed AA) to #B0A89C (5.2:1). link changed from orange (4.1:1 on band) to #F1EEEB underlined; orange kept only for large accent words (dm-accent).

font._doc: Type families. Source: style guide / toolbox. Max 2 families. family_css is the body/UI stack, display_family_css the headline stack, accent_family_css the family of the single accent word (same family, or a serif if the brand says so). Every stack ends in web-safe fallbacks. web_font_url: Google Fonts css2 URL with the exact weights used (leave empty if the brand font is not web-servable; the <link> is then removed). mso_fallback: what Outlook desktop renders.
font.name: Prompt + Playfair Display (provisional, combo A)

type._doc: Type scale in px (desktop + mobile). Source: style guide type ramp, adapted to email ranges (hero 36-52, band heading 24-32, body 16, label 11-13, legal 11-13; mobile headline never below 26). italic_accent: true if the brand highlights one word per headline in italic, false for an upright colored accent (build_kit derives accent_font_style). case_rule and label_transform come from the style guide or the brand's live emails.
type.case_rule: Headlines and subheads ALL CAPS (subheads tracked); body in sentence case; buttons ALL CAPS tracked. Accent word in orange, upright, only on dark bands.

button._doc: Button shape from the brand's live site / style guide (rectangle or pill). One shape per brand; one fill color per email. Minimum 44px tall: vertical padding x2 + line_height >= 44. Use '999px' radius for a pill.

radius._doc: Corner radii from the style guide. card_vml_arcsize is the Outlook VML equivalent of card on a 560x600 card (radius / 560, as a percent). Radii are decorative: Outlook desktop squares images.

assets._doc: Paths relative to the kit folder (assets/...). Photo crops come from the sent emails and must be swapped for the photo-bank originals. Background images (E03, E15) and torn edges (E18) are decorative and take no alt.

footer._doc: Legal footer copy. Source: the brand's legal / compliance rule (CAN-SPAM in the US, LGPD good practice in Brazil, plus any sector rule) and the brand's legal entity data. Never ship [[CONFIRMAR]] items. reason_line says why the person gets the email; legal_line carries any mandatory statement (currency, disclaimers); address is the physical mailing address.
